auto_context.card: This is an archived live stream uploaded on August 20, 2022, from the channel of Omaru Polka (尾丸ポルカ), a VTuber belonging to hololive (specifically hololive Gamers). The stream is a gameplay session of RUST, a multiplayer survival and PvP game by Facepunch Studios, played on a private hololive member server called ホロ鯖RUST. Polka describes herself as an FPS beginner and starts the session from the military base area. The tone is casual and energetic, typical of a live variety gaming stream, and the primary language is Japanese. Multiple other hololive members are also participating on the same server, so names of various hololive talents may appear in conversation.
